issues.correction: To align with the stated progression, add a micro-skill or modify an existing one to have students propose or make a single change to their prototype based on their evaluation, and then re-evaluate. issues.finding: The unit's stated progression, 'Keep the user need stable while changing one design feature,' is not implemented or assessed in the micro-skills. The current sequence focuses on a single design-build-evaluate cycle, not on iterative changes to a design feature.

issues.correction: Modify the assessment task to align with the success criteria. initial.rationale: This unit introduces third-grade students to the foundational elements of the design process: understanding what makes a product 'good' (criteria), selecting appropriate materials based on those criteria, building a physical representation (prototype), and assessing its effectiveness. By focusing on explicit criteria and simple prototypes, students develop critical thinking and practical skills essential for technological literacy. The progression emphasizes keeping the user need stable while changing one design feature, fostering an iterative mindset.
